name: Hagag Group Real Estate Entrepreneurship Ltd
summary: Hagag Group Real Estate Entrepreneurship Ltd engages in the development, management, and marketing of real estate projects in Israel. The company develops residential towers and buildings, private houses and apartments, boutique hotel, commercial buildings, and luxurious office towers and buildings. It also involved in managing, developing, and implementing urban renewal projects. Hagag Group Real Estate Entrepreneurship Ltd was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel.
